name: Storefront
summary: An online shop's home page: a slim announcement bar, your logo and name with a bag button, a search bar, your banner with a Shop now button, every option as a product tile in a grid with a Start here badge, the questions customers ask, and a shop footer.
suits: Shops and e-commerce, including shops on Shopify, Square and WooCommerce; boutiques, gift and fashion stores, bakeries and delis, and any business people come to browse and buy.
